scope: Retrospective diagnostic comparison on existing recorded data; fixed alternatives declared before this run, after previous analyses; no untouched holdout or external preregistration claim
validation: expanding-window whole UTC dates; every model uses the same evaluation rows after six within-segment history bins; training-only centering/scaling and fitting
interpretation: Predictive association and model adequacy only; a better forecast does not identify adaptive learning, and a larger lag model does not retroactively validate the rejected VAR1 covariance restrictions
retention: Retain all fixed alternatives and all held-out-date results; do not select specifications based on obtaining a passing model test
